text: Hi team, while you're in there can you also set up the returns portal for our UK and DE stores? Our ops lead assumed it was part of this. Ideally before go-live.
Quick question from our support lead: once Shopify is connected, where exactly will agents see a customer's past orders? Want to put it in the training deck.
None of us can log in to the sandbox since this morning, it says the SSO certificate is invalid. Our admins are blocked on reviewing the ticket forms.
We forgot about wholesale accounts in the workshop. Can we add three more SLA tiers for them (Gold, Silver, Bronze)? Same setup as the others.
Thanks for running the workshop on Wednesday, the team found it really useful.

note: Phrased as a small add-on ('quickly also', 'same process'), but it's a second source system and 20k more tickets. Classic scope creep.
text: Could you quickly also pull in the Freshdesk tickets from the company we acquired in 2019? It's a smaller account, maybe 20k tickets. Should be the same process as Zendesk right?
Black Friday week is going to be hard for us. Can agent training move to the week of December 1?

note: Rides on the in-scope Shopify integration, but loyalty data is explicitly out of scope.
text: Can the Shopify sidebar also show loyalty points? We use a loyalty app that writes them to the customer record.

note: Translating tier names for the DE team is a small adjustment inside an in-scope item, not new work.
text: Can the SLA policy names show in German for the DE team? Same four tiers, just translated.
For the orders@ inbox, can replies go out from orders@northwind-retail.example rather than the generic support address?
We'd like the UK ticket form to include a 'store number' field so agents know which branch the customer visited.
From today's call: their agent headcount went up to 55 after the hiring round. They asked if the setup still covers everyone.
Will the migration keep the original ticket creation dates? Our reporting depends on them.
Who from our side needs to attend the admin training? I want to block calendars this week.
Can hypercare start the Monday after go-live instead of the same day? Go-live is a Friday.
Please share the field mapping sheet for the Zendesk import so our ops lead can review it before the test run.
Can we rename the 'VIP' SLA tier to 'Premier'? That's what our stores call those customers.

note: Recording a session that's already happening costs almost nothing. Treated as in scope; a stricter PM could call it a change.
text: Is it possible to record the agent training so people who join later can watch it?
The DE ticket form should have its field labels in German please.

note: Only attachments, but from tickets older than the 2 years the SOW covers.
text: Customer asked on the call whether attachments from Zendesk tickets older than 2 years can come across too. Just the attachments, not the tickets.
We'd like the three agent groups split by region (US, UK, DE) instead of by function.
Quick check: the Shopify lookup is read only, right? Our finance team asked.
We're opening a store in France in March. Can you add an FR region form like the other three?
Could you also connect our Instagram DMs as a ticket source? A lot of customers message us there.
Can agents issue refunds from the Shopify panel instead of only seeing the orders? It would save a lot of tab switching.
Our call centre team (12 people) should be in the system too, as a fourth group with its own queue.
Can you set up a third inbox for wholesale@? Same as the other two.

note: Small, but it's a third session when the SOW says two.
text: Could we get one more agent training session? The night shift can't make either of the two slots.
Please extend hypercare to four weeks. We go live right before our busiest season.

note: Reporting isn't in the SOW at all. Sounds small, which is why it slips through.
text: Ops manager wants a dashboard of SLA breaches per store for their Monday meeting. Asked if we can build it.

note: Framed as a quick add-on while forms are being built, but CSAT surveys aren't in the SOW.
text: While you're configuring the forms, can you quickly add a CSAT survey that goes out after a ticket is closed?
Our auditors want 3 years of ticket history, not 2. Can the migration cover the extra year?
Can we set up an auto-reply for 'where is my order' emails that pulls the tracking status from Shopify?

note: A new audience and topic (team leads, reporting), not one of the agreed sessions.
text: Can you train our team leads on building reports? Separate from the agent sessions, maybe 2 hours.
The Zendesk export keeps timing out at about 40k tickets. We can't get the rest out.
Heads up, our IT team hasn't approved the Shopify app install yet, so you won't be able to connect it this week.
Our security team rejected the DNS change for orders@, so emails aren't forwarding to the new system.
Half the agents can't accept their invites, the link says it has expired.
Still waiting on Northwind to send admin credentials for the new instance. Configuration can't start without them.
The test import created duplicate customers. We've paused the mapping review until that's sorted.

note: The blocker is on the customer side (legal sign-off), but it still stops the SLA build.
text: Please hold off on the SLA build. Legal hasn't signed off on the response times yet.
Got it, thanks!

note: Useful information, but it asks for nothing.
text: Looping in Priya from our ops team, she'll be the main contact for the DE stores from now on.
Happy Diwali to the whole team!
Great call today, it really feels like we're on track.
Out of office until Monday. Contact Sam for anything urgent.
